True peak normalization via an OfflineAudioContext gain stage — no limiting, no compression. Runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an audio file.
  2. Set the target peak level (e.g. −1 dB for masters, −3 dB for podcasts).
  3. Click "Normalize" — original and new peaks are shown.
  4. Download the normalized WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does normalization work?

The highest peak is measured, then every sample is scaled so that peak hits exactly your target dB. Nothing clips, nothing is compressed.

Why can't I pick 0 dB or higher?

0 dBFS is the digital maximum — peaks can't go above it without clipping, so targets stay at or below −0.5 dB for safety.

Is my audio uploaded?

Yes — decoding, measuring and gain all happen in your browser.
